card.name: Color range descriptions of solutions
card.fires_on: Words in appearance descriptions of a drug solution or powder, such as 'pale' or 'slightly' after 'colorless to', and 'to' or 'as' just before a color. Also fires on 'isot-onic' in 'isotonic solution'.

modes.label: Color range wording
modes.description: The word after 'colorless to' that leads into a color like yellow or brown.
modes.example: the solution is clear, colorless to<< pale>> yellow.

modes.label: Appearance phrasing
modes.description: Linking words in 'appears as' or 'colorless to' before a color.
modes.example: FUROSCIX is a clear, colorless<< to>> slightly yellow solution.

modes.label: Isotonic solution
modes.description: The middle of the word isotonic in descriptions of ready-to-use solutions.

card.plain: It marks the wording that describes the color of an injection or powder, as in 'colorless to pale yellow'.
